name: Surat Trade & Merchantile Ltd
about: Surat Textile Mills Ltd is a textile manufacturing company and is part of  the Garden Group. The Co. manufactures polyester chips and differentiated partially oriented yarn [1] [2] The manufacturing business has been discontinued since FY23. The company commenced a new business of trading of certain commodities viz. Metal, Energy & Agricultural products
keyPoints:
Product Offerings
The Co. manufactures polyester chips, partially oriented yarn, mono-ethylene glycol, Purified terephthalic acid, among other chips contributing 100% of Revenue [1]The company has discontinued these operations from FY23

pros: Stock is trading at 0.55 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 12.1% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.12.5 Cr.
